messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to close the initial onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure listings this week. Tech artifacts, legal packet, and SKU/pricing mapping still open. Who can take point on each?
Tom: I can own the packaging + AMI/container artifacts for AWS and GCP images. Need final build tags and the size/region matrix.
Anika: I’ll take legal packet (EULA, SOC2 attestation, customer data flow doc). Heads up: procurement wants the indemnity language checked for Azure marketplace.
Sam: I’ll do SKU/pricing mapping and the billing metadata. Can someone confirm which plans map to reserved vs metered on each cloud?
Maria: Great — assign: Tom = artifacts, Anika = legal, Sam = pricing. Julie can you be backup on product copy and listing screenshots?
Julie: Yep. I’ll draft short product descriptions for each marketplace (focus on latency/cost benefits). Will need 3 sizes of screenshots: hero, 2x feature. Any brand constraints?
Tom: @Julie no animated gifs; PNGs only. For AWS we need AMI id + launch script, for GCP a container image in our GCR project, Azure wants the image + ARM template. I’ll post a short checklist in a sec.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace publisher account link expires in 48h: https://internal.redwood/integrations/marketplace-pub-account
Anika: Also legal needs a copy of the CSV with customer data flows per region. Sam can you attach the sample billing mapping?
Sam: Attaching snippet below for mapping (example):
```
plan_id, sku, unit_type, unit_price_usd, reserve_eligible
starter, RW-MKT-START, vCPU_hour, 0.02, false
standard, RW-MKT-STD, instance_hour, 0.12, true
enterprise, RW-MKT-ENT, subscription_month, 400, true
```
Maria: Good. Tom — add those build tags and region list to the checklist. We need to confirm AMI security scan and license metadata before legal signs off.
Tom: Will do. For AMI scanning I’ll run the vuln scan job and paste results here: `build/ami-scan/1958/results.html` once done. ETA today EOD.
Julie: For screenshots, linking our brand pack here: https://internal.redwood/brand/marketplace-assets — will use the provided logo variants. Need final product name for the listing (should be consistent across clouds).
Maria: Use `Redwood Inference — Hosted Inference` for now. Legal can flag if they want hyphenation changes.
Anika: Noted. Also need to confirm support contact and SLA text. Who owns the SLA blurb?
Sam: I can draft the SLA summary (30/60/99 p99 latency targets + support hours). Will share a one-pager.
Maria: Excellent. Timeline: today — artifacts + billing sample + legal checklist draft. Tomorrow — screenshots + SLA + publish packaging. If any blocker, escalate to me.
Tom: small question on Azure: they require a private offer vs marketplace listing for enterprise contracts. Do we want to pursue private offer for initial customers?
Maria: Good point — let's default to public listing for now, but keep private-offer materials ready. Anika, mark that as optional deliverable.
Anika: Done. I’ll prepare private-offer contract template as backup.
Julie: One more thing — marketing wants to coordinate announcement with partners once listing is live. Can partnerships own the partner communications timeline?
Maria: Yes. I’ll coordinate with growth. Post-launch checklist: announce cadence, partner badge, and co-branded asset approvals.
Sam: Uploading final CSV to /shared/marketplace/1958765432/pricing.csv when ready.
Tom: Checklist posted:
- AMI/container image built + tag
- AMI vuln scan link
- Region/size matrix
- ARM template for Azure
- Artifact manifest (sha256)
- Icons + screenshots
- License/metadata JSON
- Contact/support email

Maria: Thanks team. If no objections I’ll mark owners and send calendar for a 30-min handoff in 2pm slot.
Sam: SGTM.
Julie: 👍
Anika: 👍 I’ll ping legal for an expedited review window.
Tom: starting artifact work now.
marketplace-bot: Task created: marketplace-onboard-1958765432 (owners: Maria, Tom, Anika, Sam)
